alex: Heads-up — planning a calibration-sweep for the new 13B model across FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ. Need a concrete protocol for the calibration dataset + prompt set so bakeoffs are comparable. Thoughts?

maria: Agree we need strict stratification. My quick proposal: stratify by domain (instructions, code, QA, dialogs), token-length buckets (short/medium/long), and difficulty (anchor-based). Keep a small high-quality anchor set for human review.

jing: +1. Also add negative controls and adversarial probes to catch hallucination regressions. Recommend 1) 500 anchors (high quality) 2) 5k stratified calibration samples 3) 2k holdout evaluation set.

az: For quant experiment reproducibility: store exact prompt templates, RNG seeds, sampling params. We should report deltas per-decode-mode (greedy / beam-5 / top-p 0.9 sampling).

carla: For anchor selection, can we include: 40% QA (closed-book), 25% instructions (multi-step), 20% code completion, 15% conversations? Anchors should be locked and human-reviewed.

alex: That split seems reasonable. What about prompt variants? e.g., few-shot vs zero-shot, different system messages — need to include both or we'll miss config sensitivity.

maria: Definitely include prompt variants. Suggest: for each anchor, generate 3 variants: short instruction, few-shot (1-3 examples), and a noisy paraphrase. Label them as "variant:A/B/C".

jing: Sampling script snippet (run for each strata):
```bash
python tools/sample_calib.py \n  --source datasets/ccd.jsonl \n  --seed 42 \n  --strata domain,length,difficulty \n  --n_per_strata 200 \n  --out calib/2026-03-sweep.jsonl
```
This produces deterministic picks and metadata for traceability.

az: Also capture per-example token-length histogram and KV-cache warmup behavior. For deployment profiles we need buckets: short(<=64), med(65-512), long(>512). Report latency and memory each bucket.

carla: On evaluation metrics: for QA use exact-match / F1; for code use pass@1 / compile rate; for instructions use BLEU + human preference sampling. Also track perplexity drift for open-gen.

maria: For quant acceptance thresholds, propose: safety-critical tasks <= 1% absolute drop in EM/F1; non-critical <= 3% absolute. For code pass@1 maybe <= 2% drop. Anything beyond triggers a manual review + rollback plan.

aj: (typo) — ignore

alex: How do we incorporate GPTQ/AWQ-specific artifacts? e.g., per-layer outlier stats, calibration-input sensitivity?

jing: Save quantization metadata per-run: per-layer scale/zero-point, outlier counts, max-activation histograms. Add these as JSON blobs alongside results so we can correlate accuracy deltas.

carla: Can we add a simple scoring CSV format so dashboards can ingest it? Columns: model, quant_scheme, decode_mode, strata, metric_name, metric_value, delta_vs_fp16, latency_ms, mem_mb, seed, run_id, artifact_link

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: quant-calib-sweep-1902345678 -> runs on cycle ci/quant-sweeps, outputs to s3://redwood-experiments/quant_calib/1902345678/

maria: One more thing — ensure prompts include "edge format" cases for structured outputs (JSON tables) to test integrity after quant. Often quant breaks subtle tokenization ordering.

az: Good call. Add a small set (200) of structured-output anchors. We should also compute structural validation scores (JSON parse success, schema diff).

alex: OK actionable items: 1) jing to produce sampling script PR + default strata config, 2) carla to assemble anchor set and human-review plan, 3) maria to draft acceptance thresholds + metrics mapping, 4) zach to add dashboard CSV schema and perf buckets. I'll kick off the infra job.

carla: I'll start triaging anchors today, ping me if you have candidate prompts. :thumbsup:

jing: prepping PR now, ETA EOD.

az: I'll write the post-bakeoff checklist for manual review.

alex: Thanks — let's keep this thread for updates. If anyone adds new strata or changes thresholds, call it out explicitly.
